arcs.title: The Porch Railing Situation
arcs.summary: Day 2: The railing creaked once at dusk with no wind. Steve has logged it. Adam was consulted by Floo and has offered to come Saturday, pending. Don's portrait revealed the northeast corner was shimmed with a piece of a cabinet door, which he stands by. Christine has updated the household ledger. The railing has not creaked again. Day 3 should bring Adam's visit, or a further escalation — perhaps the railing does something more definitive (a second creak in response to a question, Steve and Adam's initial inspection, or Don's portrait producing a diagram of the original construction that raises more questions than it answers).
